title: Keepers of Strength and Wisdom
summary: Complete the Keepers' scroll challenges to release the Strength and Wisdom trials.
overview: Complete the Keepers' scroll challenges to release the Strength and Wisdom trials.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare for all five Strength protectors before accepting that trial.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Give the Keeper of Strength the four required scrolls to reveal the Spirit Keeper.
Tell the Spirit Keeper you are worthy to summon five ancient protectors.
The Keeper of Wisdom accepts its separate four-scroll set and sends the party to Sung Li downstairs.

notes: Approval E318. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The separate Sung Li Wisdom sequence needs a deeper publication review; this draft establishes both activation branches.
